properties.name: feed.score.recency-weight
properties.description: Weight applied to the recency component of the feed ranking score (0–1). Weights must sum to 1.0.

properties.name: feed.score.engagement-weight
properties.description: Weight applied to the engagement component of the feed ranking score (0–1). Weights must sum to 1.0.

properties.name: feed.score.affinity-weight
properties.description: Weight applied to the affinity component of the feed ranking score (0–1). Weights must sum to 1.0.

properties.name: feed.score.self-affinity
properties.description: Affinity multiplier for the author's own posts (0–1). Lower than FOLLOWEE (1.0) so own posts rank slightly below followee posts of equal age and engagement.
